note: Public beta data snapshot; source currently identifies itself as 7.0.54, not an official 7.1 release. attack/subStat follow the existing calculator display rounding; attackRaw/subStatRaw and raw curves are retained.

semanticNotes.NewBough: Stellar Glimmer mode replaces normal Verdant: it grants ATK + Stellar Glimmer damage per stack, without retaining normal-mode Elemental Mastery.
semanticNotes.WintersHeavyHeart: Stellar Glimmer mode replaces the normal Cryo/Electro effects. Count all Cryo/Electro party members including the wielder, at most four total.
semanticNotes.BreezeborneRefrain: Energy Recharge increases by refinement: 20%/25%/30%/35%/40%. This stat is omitted from the source parameters array, so it is extracted from and cross-checked between the Chinese and English descriptions. The stack-triggered 12-second Stellar Glimmer damage buff applies to nearby party members; triggering is possible off field.
semanticNotes.ForgedByTheGoldenMelody: The extra Contrapuntal movement snapshots the movement at its trigger and lasts 12 seconds. It need not match the currently cycling base movement.
semanticNotes.Frostbreath: Flat energy regeneration is for the other party members, not the wielder; it must not be converted into an Energy Recharge statistic.
semanticNotes.SongOfTheVigil: Flat energy regeneration is for the wielder and must not be converted into an Energy Recharge statistic.
semanticNotes.JadeVista: At most three other party members; same-element Elemental Mastery stacks take priority if given an overfull composition.

refinementDetails.name: 独光的赐坠
refinementDetails.description: 装备者施放元素战技后，获得「映落瞳中的初光」：持续期间，将记录装备者的移动距离，每秒都将基于上一秒记录的移动距离，使装备者获得最低<color=#99FFFFFF>18%</color>、最高<color=#99FFFFFF>36%</color>的攻击力加成。该效果持续14秒，每14秒至多触发一次，并会在装备者退场时移除。
refinementDetails.descriptionEnglish: After the equipping character uses their Elemental Skill, they gain "Gleam of First Light." While active, Gleam of First Light tracks their distance traveled. Each second, the equipping character gains an ATK Bonus ranging from <color=#99FFFFFF>18%</color> to <color=#99FFFFFF>36%</color> based on the distance traveled during the previous second. Gleam of First Light lasts 14s, can be triggered once every 14s, and is removed when the equipping character leaves the field.

refinementDetails.description: 施放元素战技后的12秒内，装备者的攻击命中敌人时，会获得「蓊郁」：攻击力提升<color=#99FFFFFF>4%</color>，元素精通提升<color=#99FFFFFF>20</color>点。该效果持续6秒，至多叠加3层，每1秒至多触发一次。装备者处于队伍后台时，依然能触发上述效果。\n辉映·星烁：「蓊郁」效果改为攻击力提升<color=#99FFFFFF>6%</color>，且装备者造成的星烁反应伤害提升<color=#99FFFFFF>8%</color>。
refinementDetails.descriptionEnglish: When the equipping character hits the opponent with an attack within 12s after using the Elemental Skill, they gain the "Verdant" effect, which increases their ATK by <color=#99FFFFFF>4%</color> and their Elemental Mastery by <color=#99FFFFFF>20</color>. This effect lasts 6s and can trigger once every second. Max 3 stacks. The aforementioned effects can still trigger even when the equipping character is not on the field.\nRadiance: Stellar Glimmer: The effect of "Verdant" is changed to: Increases ATK by <color=#99FFFFFF>6%</color> as well as Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by the equipping character by <color=#99FFFFFF>8%</color>.

refinementDetails.name: 交奏的昼与夜
refinementDetails.description: 每10秒，装备者按照以下顺序，分别奏响对应效果的「谐律乐章」：攻击力提升<color=#99FFFFFF>18%</color>/元素精通提升<color=#99FFFFFF>120</color>点/星烁反应伤害提升<color=#99FFFFFF>28%</color>，每种乐章效果持续10秒，装备者处于队伍后台时，依然能触发上述效果。\n触发星烁反应后，还会额外获得持续12秒的、与触发星烁反应时演奏乐章效果相同的「谐律乐章·复调」，该效果可以与原本的乐章效果叠加，每12秒至多触发一次。
refinementDetails.descriptionEnglish: Every 10s, the equipping character plays a "Harmonic Movement" of the corresponding type for a boost in the following order: <color=#99FFFFFF>+18%</color> ATK > <color=#99FFFFFF>+120</color> Elemental Mastery > <color=#99FFFFFF>+28%</color> Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG. Each instance of Harmonic Movement lasts 10s. This effect can trigger even when the equipping character is not on the field.\nTriggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction will also grant an additional 12-second instance of "Harmonic Movement: Contrapuntal" with the same effects as the Harmonic Movement active when Stellar Glimmer is triggered. This effect stacks with the original Harmonic Movement effect, and can trigger once every 12s.

refinementDetails.name: 蝰蛇的谣歌
refinementDetails.description: 元素充能效率提升<color=#99FFFFFF>20%</color>。装备者的元素战技或元素爆发命中敌人时，获得一层「纯净者的圣咏」，该效果至多叠加3层，每0.03秒至多获得一层。叠加至3层时，将清除所有「纯净者的圣咏」，获得「蛇信的死毒」：使队伍中附近的所有角色造成的星烁反应伤害提升<color=#99FFFFFF>24%</color>，持续12秒，期间无法再次获得「纯净者的圣咏」。装备者处于队伍后台时，依然能触发上述效果。
refinementDetails.descriptionEnglish: Increases Energy Recharge by <color=#99FFFFFF>20%</color>. When the equipping character hits the opponent with their Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, they gain a stack of "Hymn of the Pure." This effect can trigger once every 0.03s, max 3 stacks, and at 3 stacks, all instances of "Hymn of the Pure" are cleared to give the equipping character "Thus Lied the Viper" instead. This grants nearby party characters a <color=#99FFFFFF>24%</color> Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG boost for 12s, during which no stacks of "Hymn of the Pure" can be obtained. The aforementioned effects can still trigger even when the equipping character is not on the field.
